title: Stonewashed Linen Throw
description: Stonewashed linen in warm oat. Gets softer with every wash. The kind of thing you reach for without thinking.

title: Handthrown Ceramic Mug
description: A mug made to be held. Slightly irregular, uneven glaze in warm clay. Each one is different; that's the point.

title: Seagrass Storage Basket
description: Woven seagrass with a wide opening. Stores blankets, holds magazines, earns its place in a corner just by existing.

title: Undyed Linen Napkins (Set of 4)
description: Raw-edge linen in natural undyed flax. They wrinkle beautifully. Set them out folded loosely — that's the whole look.

title: Mango Wood Serving Tray
description: A wide, low tray in oiled mango wood. For morning coffee arrangements, for gathering the things that accumulate on a counter.

title: Frosted Glass Bud Vase
description: A narrow-necked glass vase in soft sage. Made for a single stem, a sprig of eucalyptus, or nothing at all.
